name: China Resources Chemical Innovative Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: China Resources Chemical Innovative Materials Co., Ltd., based in Changzhou, China, and established in 2003, primarily focuses on the global and domestic manufacturing and distribution of non-fiber grade polyester chips. The company's key product is its Hualei-branded bottle-grade polyester chips, which are utilized across a wide range of applications. These include packaging for drinking water, hot-filled and carbonated beverages, edible oils, and alcohol, as well as components for medical blood collection tubes, films, and sheets, among other uses. Beyond its core production, the firm also engages in export and wholesale activities, provides warehousing services, and facilitates sales through online channels. It operates as a subsidiary of China Resources Chemical Materials Investment Co., Ltd.
